title: Zizzy Street
location: Basketball Court in front of Pyeongbong Field
description: The official Zizzy street showcase of the term! Experience intense locking, popping, and hip-hop dance performances directly on the central campus courts.

title: GHOST CTF Hackathon
description: Intense 24-hour Capture-The-Flag (CTF) security challenge hosted by HGU’s elite cybersecurity team GHOST. Test your skills in web hacking, pwn, cryptography, and reverse engineering.

title: Holy Rams Open Tryouts
description: Looking for tactical athletes. No experience necessary. We teach you standard American football regulations, drills, and physical safety mechanics.

title: Orchestra Classical Concert
description: An evening of symphonic orchestration presenting classical masterpieces and HGU praise adaptations. Tickets required for auditorium seat reservation.

title: CRA Artificial Intelligence Lecture
description: Open guest lecture reviewing advanced transformer models and software development frameworks. General entry is free for all university members.

title: Giving Tree Service Outing
description: Volunteer excursion supporting the elderly. General body members coordinate singing performances, health stretches, and distribute warm home-cooked meals.
